definitions.esm_binder_plddt_mean: Mean saved ESMFold2-Fast per-residue pLDDT of binder chain B in the bound complex; scale0–100. Not AlphaFold2 pLDDT.
definitions.esm_complex_plddt_mean: Mean saved ESMFold2-Fast per-residue pLDDT over chains A+B; scale0–100.
definitions.esm_interchain_pae_mean_A: Arithmetic mean of both full cross-chain PAE blocks A→B and B→A; Å; no contact filtering.
definitions.esm_interchain_pae_div31: Same cross-chain PAE divided by31 as a BindCraft-style normalized analogue; does not imply AF2 equivalence.
definitions.rosetta_interface_sc: Existing InterfaceAnalyzerMover interface_data.sc_value on unrelaxed ESMFold2-Fast complex.
definitions.rosetta_interface_hbonds: Existing InterfaceAnalyzerMover interface_data.interface_hbonds on unrelaxed ESMFold2-Fast complex.
definitions.interface_K_count: Number of distinct binder Lys residues with any atom within4Å of any antigen atom, using pinned BindCraft hotspot_residues on saved unrelaxed scoring PDB.
definitions.interface_M_count: Same as Kcount for binder Met.

notes: No AF2 result substituted or renamed; all confidence metrics are ESMFold2-Fast-derived analogues.
Existing Rosetta features are unrelaxed, unlike the relaxed-structure BindCraft filtering workflow.
Unavailable requested feature values are null, not zero. K/M zero values arise from actual contact counts.
